threads.name: Treasure map
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the Barrow Mound treasure is not tied to the map.

threads.name: Dragon hunt (Eric the Reeve's bounty)
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi took Sir Brandon's magic sword (beat_61) and the party set out a plan, but the dragon still lives, so the hunt continues with an added resource.

threads.name: Fairies appearing more often
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the myth of a fairy-given sword does not explain why fairies are appearing.

threads.name: Ingrid and Warwick (Dunk's deal)
threads.note: The party plans to carry out Dunk's scheme with Ingrid after the Barrow, but it has not been done.

threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance for Father William
threads.note: Dr. Uriah reached the Barrow Mound but did no penance and made no donation; still owed.

threads.name: Squints' share of the treasure
threads.note: The party gathered its first treasure, but Squints has not yet made his promised second pick.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's hire
threads.note: The party hired Ned under an ongoing arrangement paying them for murders and bodies, and he has offered a deal on the goblin corpses that would need sneaking past the goblins.

threads.name: Protection against the black dragon's poison
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi's plan states that protection from the witch or alchemist is needed because the black dragon is poisonous, so it serves the dragon hunt.

threads.name: The Free Goblin Society bargain
threads.note: The party promised to clear the evil from the mound and keep the goblins' presence from King Hogboon in return for their home there; the evil is not yet cleared.

threads.name: The undead giant in the Barrow Mound
threads.note: A huge undead swordsman, apparently one of Brandon's companions, has killed many goblins and has just appeared in the tomb doorway (beat_62); the danger is live.

threads.name: The robes of Saint Arthur
threads.note: Dr. Uriah wears the holy robes untested for magic, over Brother Dirk's deep offense; both the robes' nature and Dirk's grievance remain open.

threads.name: The noblewoman statue
threads.note: The riddle was answered, but whom the speaking noblewoman statue depicts remains an unanswered question.

threads.name: Brother Dirk's claim on the chalice
threads.note: Dirk suggested the jeweled chalice belongs to the church and Trout deferred the question until later.

standalone_beats.reason: The recently opened door was a notable clue, explained by the goblins' arrival.
The real gemstones in the mosaics are a notable potential source of wealth.
Squints killed the gray ooze and was praised as Trout's apprentice.
The four virtue statues supplied the answers to the tomb's riddle.
Sir Phidipaldi was blessed with good fortune for the rest of the Barrow Mound adventure.
